message:
Fix Dynamo opaque object staticmethod guards (#188632)

Value opaque objects are represented as TorchScriptObjectVariable, whose constructor accepted a source but did not pass it to UserDefinedObjectVariable. That left the base class without the instance source it needs to derive cls_source for descriptor lookup.

When Dynamo traced an instance access to a @staticmethod on a value opaque object, staticmethod handling fell back to the runtime instance attribute source, for example G['q'].get_shape, and then appended .__func__. That source is invalid because Python instance access of a staticmethod returns the wrapped function directly, and plain functions do not have __func__, so guard construction raised AttributeError.

Forward the source to the base initializer so the existing class-dict descriptor source is available. This keeps staticmethod guard sources rooted at the class descriptor, where .__func__ is valid, instead of adding a narrow special case for opaque objects.

Fixes #188544
Generated by my agent
